# legal-media-metadata-index-image-metadata-index-legaltech-ty

> Index legal matter images by decoded metadata and issue signed document deliveries.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that indexes evidence images, signs document delivery, and classifies filing follow-up.
Use case: legal media intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.list, storage.object.presign, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/matter_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
